1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Two broad apertures follow one translating bilateral blot. Coupled drift makes both positions move, with no deformation.
1.natural_language: Inspect the ink centres with the pointer to uncover their registration marks. Each sheet assigns the apertures differently; uncovered marks stay visible. Keep every ink centre inside its marked registration aperture to develop the butterfly print. The apertures have inertia. Uncovered ink fills the spill gutter and the print fades. The dotted fibres show the next 1.2 seconds of flow; fading fibres show the recent past. Begin flow when ready. A full gutter, expired sheet, or incomplete certification ends the episode. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. full.summary: Inspect ink centres with the pointer to reveal the same persistent registration marks in both modes. Drag each visible aperture by its ring or centre to set its motor aim. The aperture accelerates toward that aim.

simplified.summary: Inspect ink centres with the pointer to reveal the same persistent registration marks in both modes. Select a labelled aperture proxy, then click its motor aim in the same field. Identical aperture physics, flow, visibility and grading tolerances.
